name: push-tag-policy-surfaces
body:
The binary-doc and git-test surfaces that state the binary's push/tag policy as human-approved acts:

- `Cargo.toml` — the git2 `default-features = false` comment (line 20).
- `src/git/mod.rs` — the module doc's push/tag sentence (line 6).
- `src/project_cmd/mod.rs` — the `apg project merge` doc's push/tag sentence (line 28).
- `src/plan_cmd/verify.rs` — the `apg plan verify` merge-handoff string (line 200, "…push/tag remain human-approved") inside `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.plan_verify_at`.
- `tests/git_e2e.rs` — the R6 comment (line 952) and the git-CLI-shellout assertion message (line 972).
- `tests/project_cmd_e2e.rs` — the R6 row's prose (line 312).

The component is a NARROW owner: its `implemented-by` set is exactly the files/functions above, so the verify gate's derived solution coverage (`rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check`) enforces exactly those FQNs. It is `realised-by` `domain.entity.release-agent-flow` — the entity that carries the push/tag policy and the binary's git2-only statement — alongside the reused agent-policy components (`solution.component.agent-builder-prompt`, `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt`, `solution.component.agent-roster-docs`).

implemented-by: `Cargo.toml`, `src/git/mod.rs`, `src/project_cmd/mod.rs`, `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.plan_verify_at`, `tests/git_e2e.rs`, `tests/project_cmd_e2e.rs`.
